neighbours.label: descriptions of protein structure: residues, side chains and subunits
fire: In the crystal structure, the zinc ion is held by the side chains of three histidine residues.
Mutating the conserved residues in the binding pocket abolished enzyme activity.
The catalytic subunit binds ATP in a cleft lined by hydrophobic residues.
Two cysteine residues form a disulfide bond that stabilises the loop.
The kinase has a regulatory subunit that blocks the active site.
Hydrogen bonds link the substrate to the backbone of residues 45 to 52.
A salt bridge between lysine and glutamate side chains holds the helices together.
The receptor's ligand-binding domain contains several aromatic residues.
quiet: In the photograph, the old bridge is held up by three stone arches.
Changing the rules in the second half abolished the team's advantage.
The main office stores files in a cabinet lined with metal shelves.
Two old friends formed a band that played in the town square.
The company has a regional office that handles local orders.
Wooden pegs link the beams to the frame of the barn.
A long rope between the two boats held them together in the storm.
The museum's main hall contains several marble statues.

notes: Card mixes biochemistry ('coordinated by the side chains of Arg393', 'regulatory subunit') with thanking/crediting; probe 'side chains of two residues' 0.51, 'thanked her coach' 0.23. Tested the biochemistry reading.
